system.description:
Acquired with CR 11 or higher. Use this skill when you would receive HP Damage. Reduce the expected HP Damage by -[SRx5].

(CR21): Change [SRx5] to [SRx7]

A special skill that reduces damage by blocking enemy attacks with a strong part of the equipment. The proof of a superior <Guardian Warrior> is the ability to dare to step into the line of death to minimize injuries.
